en.title: TennoCon 2026: Warframe's Tau Galaxy and Soulframe's New Fables Revealed
en.summary: Digital Extremes pulled back the curtain on massive expansions for both Warframe and Soulframe at TennoCon 2026. Players are heading to a new galaxy and unlocking darkside powers.
en.body:
TennoCon 2026 has officially concluded, and developer **Digital Extremes** delivered a wealth of new information for its beloved online action RPGs, **Warframe** and **Soulframe**. The annual fan event, held in London, Ontario, showcased anticipated updates that will propel players into uncharted territories and introduce formidable new adversaries.

## Warframe Ventures to the Tau System

The long-awaited **Tau** expansion for **Warframe** was finally unveiled, with developers calling it the most significant evolution in the game's history. This monumental update will transport players to the enigmatic Tau system, a distant galaxy filled with Orokin-terraformed colonies and the mysterious Sentinels. The centerpiece of this new frontier is Forax, a grim, cyberpunk-inspired city that serves as a new hub zone. Forax will blend open exploration with procedurally generated areas, offering a distinct experience from existing open-world zones like the Plains of Eidolon or Fortuna. While not a traditional open world, it promises to merge the expansive feel of **Warframe**'s larger areas with the focused action of its bite-sized zones. The narrative continues to explore the ongoing conflict between the Tenno, **Albrecht Entradi**, and the elusive Man in the Wall.

Beyond the new galaxy, **Warframe** players can look forward to the **Iceblade of Narin**, a new weapon set to debut, and the introduction of an entirely new type of Warframe to control, details of which are still emerging. These additions promise to shake up combat and strategic possibilities for the game's dedicated player base.

## Soulframe's Dark Fables and New Adventures

**Soulframe**, **Digital Extremes**' upcoming fantasy-infused online action RPG, also received substantial reveals. The event showcased a new fable questline that delves deeper into the game's rich lore and introduces players to new darkside powers they can wield. These abilities are expected to offer unique gameplay styles and further customization for Envoys.

Furthermore, **Soulframe** players can anticipate the arrival of new player mounts, which will undoubtedly enhance traversal across its vast world. A new fishing mini-game was also teased, adding a more relaxed, yet potentially rewarding, activity to the game's ecosystem. **Jennifer English**, the voice of The Empress of Eldveil, made a special appearance during a **Soulframe** Devstream, offering fans a direct connection to the game's narrative and characters.

## What This Means for Players

TennoCon 2026 has clearly set an ambitious course for both **Warframe** and **Soulframe**. The expansion into the Tau system represents a bold new chapter for the decade-old **Warframe**, potentially revitalizing the game for its millions of registered players. For **Soulframe**, these reveals build significant hype for its upcoming launch, showcasing a commitment to deep lore and diverse gameplay mechanics. The sold-out nature of the in-person event, alongside the availability of digital and merchandise packs, underscores the passionate global community that **Digital Extremes** cultivates.

## What's Next

While specific release dates for the **Tau** expansion and further **Soulframe** content have not yet been announced, **Digital Extremes** has confirmed that more details will be shared in the coming months. Players are encouraged to stay tuned to official **Warframe** and **Soulframe** channels for the latest updates.

content_raw: TennoCon 2026 has finally wrapped, and developer Digital Extremes has revealed new content for both Warframe and Soulframe – it's two massive online action RPGs. Throughout the TennoCon live show, we got to see the developers showcase long-anticipated updates that will not only take players to new locations but also introduce new antagonists for the larger stories ahead in both live-service games. In addition to the long-form reveal of Warframe's Tau expansion, which introduces a new galaxy to explore that's filled with new threats, we saw Soulframe showcase a new fable questline focusing on the reveal of a new weapon and darkside powers to adopt, along with the anticipated arrival of new player mounts and a new fishing mini-game. Continue below for everything revealed at TennoCon 2026! Warframe - Tau revealed, Iceblade of Narin, and a new type of Warframe to control The long-anticipated Tau expansion for Warframe was finally revealed at TennoCon 2026, and according to the developers, it's the biggest shift forward for the long-running action-RPG that the devs have ever made. Continuing the conflict among the Tenno, Albrecht Entradi, and the enigmatic Man in the Wall, players will finally venture to the long-teased Tau system, which houses the mysterious Sentinels and the Orokin-terraformed colonies. The signature location of Tau is the gloomy, alien, cyberpunk-style city known as the Forax, a new Hub zone that blends open exploration with procedurally generated zones. While not an open-world zone in the vein of the Planes of Eidolon or Fortuna, it does feel like a mix between large-scape areas of Warframe and the bite-sized action zones throughout the game. "Tau is certainly the biggest shift for Warframe ever, we're adding a full second solar system to explore and have new stories coming," said Warframe creative director Rebecca Ford in an early interview with IGN. "When it came to building up Tau, what we basically asked ourselves was, 'How do we keep Warframe going forever?" And the answer to that was to add a second solar system to the game. 13 years later, you can build up all over again, give the players more, and start planet by planet, moon by moon. and object by object. And there's so much more to come." Another of the signature reveals in the live demo for Warframe was a new type of Warframe known as Brysko (voiced by Matt Mercer of Critical Role fame), a special Chimera Warframe that is a sentient being created within the Tau system. Along with a playable Lotus section, we also got to see Brysko in action, who plays as a gunslinger Warframe in combat sequences that play out similarly to a fast-paced character action game. Warframe has focused heavily on character-first storytelling in recent years, and one of the key focuses of the Tau update is Brysko's story and how the Chimera Warframe will play into the game's future.
